rule: Go: calls in package-level `var` initializers have caller `pkg.init` (they run during package initialization). Builtins (`len`, `append`, `make`, `panic`, …) are not calls: no edge.
source: KNOWN_GAP: calls in package-level var initializers get no edges
notes: Calls in package-level var initializers have caller pkg.init = example.com/m.init (Decisions 2026-10-29 Go). len("abc") is a builtin: no edge. Reading greeting/config/size in main is variable access, not a call. The map literal is data construction.
